name: Family Divided
overview: Scripture reveals that allegiance to Christ can bring division even within the closest of family relationships, as Jesus Himself warns that His coming will not bring peace but a sword, setting family members against one another (Matthew 10:34-35). This theme echoes the prophecy in Micah 7:6, where familial dishonor and conflict are described as a sign of spiritual and social upheaval. These divisions underscore the cost of discipleship and the call to prioritize loyalty to Christ above earthly ties, reminding believers to remain vigilant against hypocrisy and trust in God's sovereign care amid trials (Luke 12:1, 6, 25).
